import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/outlierr/2022_waste.csv')

# Load the adjacency data
adjacency_df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Get the neighbors of City of London
city_neighbors = adjacency_df[adjacency_df['borough'] == 'City of London']['neighbor'].tolist()

# Get the values of City of London and its neighbors
city_value = df[df['borough'] == 'City of London']['Waste_value'].values[0]
neighbor_values = df[df['borough'].isin(city_neighbors)]['Waste_value'].values

# Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the neighbor values
neighbor_mean = np.mean(neighbor_values)
neighbor_std = np.std(neighbor_values)

# Calculate the z-score of City of London's value
z_score = (city_value - neighbor_mean) / neighbor_std

print('z_score:', z_score)
```
